paper_title: Shortest Path to a Segment and Quickest Visibility Queries
source_locator: Explicit open question on PDF page 6
statement: We do not know how to take advantage of the fact that windows are quite special – maximal free-space segments anchored at vertices of D. On one hand this makes our solution more general, as it applies to arbitrary segments; on the other hand, it leaves open the possibility of designing a more efficient algorithm tailored to the special case of windows.
